description: Convenience: plan + apply a rename in one call. An entity (omit `method`) or a service/controller method (pass `method`). Rewrites every call-site + route handler and renames the files/folders. ⚠️ Modifies files on disk. Prefer plan_rename_* then apply_edits when you want to review first.

configSync.description: With strapi-plugin-config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views) to the new names. Default: true (the strapiDevkit.configSync.followRefactors setting; DEVKIT_CONFIG_SYNC_FOLLOW_REFACTORS=0 for a standalone server). Pass false when config/sync is not yours to change here (exported from another environment). The plan's warnings say which sync files it updates, or leaves with the old names.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

method.description: Pass to rename a method; omit to rename the entity.

newName.description: The new method name (with `method`), else the UID's new last segment (api::product.product + item → api::product.item).

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

ref.description: A Strapi reference: a content-type or component UID (api::article.article, shared.seo), a service / controller / policy / middleware ref (api::article.article, plugin::users-permissions.user, global::is-owner), or a route handler (api::article.article.find). `ref#method` targets one method.

name: apply_rename
title: Rename a Strapi entity or method (writes files)
